items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: Bill Johnson was on the bass. And Johnny Dot, he was on drums.

ctx.x: Bill Johnson was on the bass. And Johnny Dot, he was on drums. And that was about all of the combination then.
I was going to ask you, well, I think I would sort of interrupt, but about Roy Palmer. We stopped and said hello to him yesterday. I interviewed him a couple years ago.
